title: Games on deBruijn Graphs and Cycle Means
summary: deBruijn graphs are widely used in genomics and computer science. In this paper we present a novel approach to finding weights on edges of doubly weighted deBruijn graphs. Given any fixed set of weights on vertices, we use a repeated two-person zero-sum game to find weights on edges so that every cycle on the deBruijn graph has the same average weight, providing explicit formulas. This approach uses minimax optimal strategies of the players.
